text:
ryan: Heads-up — canary rollout for merge PR #4823 (commit abcdef1) is showing a p95 decode latency jump ~2.3x on short-sequence tails. Noticed after yesterday's fused-attn+kv-prefetch change.

jia: :eyes: seeing same in dashboards — p50 fine but p95 and p99 for seq<=16 spiked around the merge time. Canary cohort is 10% dedicated.

ci-bot: PERF JOB FAILED: jobs/bench/decode-canary (build 1782) — p95 increased from 18ms -> 42ms (regression threshold 1.3x) — link: http://ci.internal/redwood/build/1782

marie: Can someone post the flamegraph from the canary traces? want to see which kernel landed more work.

ryan: attaching quick flame excerpt (from perf-collect on canary):

```
Top: fused_attn_kernel::forward
  -> matmul_kernel_v2
  -> kv_prefetch_worker
  -> kv_cache_memcpy
```

Looks like more time in matmul_kernel_v2 and kv_cache_memcpy compared to baseline.

sam: Hypothesis: kernel selector might be preferring matmul_v2 for short seqs due to aggregated heuristic (throughput favored). That combined with kv prefetch reorder could be introducing extra memcpy on the decode hotpath.

jia: Agreed. I ran a local microbench: short-seq decode 8 tokens, with kernel_selector=heuristic_a (current) vs fallback heuristic_b (old). Results: heuristic_a p95=38ms, heuristic_b p95=17ms. So selection change looks causal.

ryan: Also saw KV cache churn in traces — more frequent allocations and memcpy calls. Could be prefetch window overlapping with fused-attn scheduling.

marie: Any CI bisect candidates? which commits landed in PR #4823?

ryan: PR merged 2025-11-03. Commits: abcdef1 (fuse+selector enable), abcdef2 (kv-prefetch reorder), abcdef3 (matmul kernel v2). Quick bisect plan: revert kv-prefetch reorder first (small blast radius) then matmul v2.

eng-oncall: Can we hold rollout? current canary is 10% but multiple customers hit tail reg. Suggest pausing new rollouts and pinning dedicated to previous stable.

marie: +1 hold rollout. I'll flip rollout policy to pause and pin existing hosts to stable image.

sam: To reproduce locally:

```
# repro with canary commit
python tools/profiler/run.py --profile decode --model gpt-small --seq 8 --commit abcdef1 --traces 100
```
Also try toggling kernel selector: 

```
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=heuristic_b
```

jia: I ran that repro and collected heap/pprof. Attaching a snippet of `pprof --text` showing kv_cache_memcpy dominated.

ryan: Action items:
- marie: pause rollout and pin stable (done)
- sam: run bisect between abcdef2 and abcdef3, see which revert drops p95 (own)
- jia: gather full flamegraphs + pprof and post links
- ryan: prepare hotfix for kernel selector fallback path if bisect inconclusive

sam: Starting bisect now. If anyone sees a quick fix candidate, shout here.

ci-bot: NOTE: canary metrics retained in perf dashboard for 72h — snapshot: http://perf.internal/snapshots/3951234567

marie: Thx team. Keep thread updated. We'll target a canary revert or hotfix in the next 2 hours depending on bisect.

ryan: FYI if we revert kv-prefetch reorder and p95 drops we still may want a smarter gating in the selector for short-seq latency. Follow-up RFC incoming.

jia: Posting links to artifacts: flame: http://perf.internal/flame/3951234567, pprof: http://perf.internal/pprof/3951234567.

sam: Bisect result: reverting abcdef2 (kv-prefetch reorder) brings p95 back to baseline in my local cluster. Pushing revert PR now: #4830.

ryan: Nice — once CI passes we'll roll revert to canary and monitor. If stable, plan full revert and then rework prefetch ordering with tests gated on short-seq. :thumbsup:
